features.annual: Equal-month mean temperature; log1p(sum monthly precipitation). Both computed from the same 24 physical layers as all other families.
features.variability: Annual columns plus warmest-minus-coldest monthly mean temperature and population coefficient of variation of monthly precipitation (ratio, ddof=0). These summaries are unchanged by month permutation.
features.monthly: All four previous columns plus 12 monthly temperature deviations from annual mean and 12 monthly precipitation fractions. Exact nested representations; calendar timing is retained.

dtype: Compute definitions in float64 from source physical float32, then store model columns in float32. Never standardize from held distributions.
candidate_origin: Unchanged four settings from the frozen genus seasonal comparison; no candidate change in response to N/S empirical scores. These are developmental spatial comparisons.
objective: Native CatBoost weighted BCE; equal total occupied-cell and area/inclusion-weighted background mass, each total n_presence.
regularization: Effective Newton leaf damping r*n_presence; native l2_leaf_reg divided by mean object weight, as in the verified objective supplement.
quantization: 128 GreedyLogSum training-only cutoffs from all 28 columns; smaller families receive the identical cutoff prefix for their common columns.
split_policy: Reuse the group-filtered all_1km paired N/S three-fold design exactly. Inner training presences/domains intersect outer training with another fold training; validation intersects outer training with that other fold held. Require 30 km WGS84 separation after both effective source radii (1 km for unknown only). Preserve inherited linked-source exclusions. Draw inner quadrature within each own-species intersected domain with forced training presences.
selection: Each species/family/outer setting uses maximum equal-inner-fold occupied-50km-block mean relative-density log score. Require at least two eligible inner folds; complete all candidates. Ties within 1e-10 follow candidate order. Fixed baseline fallback when fewer than two eligible inner folds; do not relax the 20-training-cell minimum after seeing results.
selection_scope: Freeze all 18 selections before any separate-species outer evaluation. North has [2,2,2] eligible inner folds; South [2,1,1]. Two southern inner candidates have 17 training cells and remain ineligible.
evaluation: Both selected and matched fixed baseline for all three families on identical held cells and full physical native target areas. An identical selected baseline is an exact alias, never a repeated fit.
primary_score: Equal occupied50km-block mean held relative-recorded-density log score per fold, then equal three-fold mean within species. All paired fold differences retained. Do not rank absolute scores across different species landscapes.
secondary_scores: source AP/log loss/Brier under half-record half-landscape mixture
prediction concentration and entropy effective-area fraction
inner_prediction_storage: All validation-cell margins, exact full-landscape normalizer and 256 evenly spaced native-index prediction audit values; full target margins are reconstructed independently during verification rather than stored for every search candidate.
outer_prediction_storage: All native target margins and cell scores are retained; no clipping or thinning for evaluation.
interpretation: Predictive information from nested representations, conditional on this learner and small tuning budget; not causal seasonal effects, physiological tolerance, an effort correction or a test of genetic lineages.
authorization: Kevin 30 September: take the established northern/southern species split as the main biological premise and proceed; extra N/S niche differentiation remains a separate supplementary question.
biological_units: Northern S. hammondii sensu stricto and unnamed southern Spea species. Inherited geographic occurrence assignments stay distinct from direct genetic evidence. Source taxon strings are preserved.
reuse_other_species: Reuse verified intermontana, bombifrons and multiplicata seasonal comparisons from 2026-09-30-genus-seasonal-comparison-v2 without refitting. Their five-fold 50-km design differs from this three-fold 30-km design.
